messages:
mira: kicking off prod deploy for routing-service v2; feature flag traffic_slice_v2 will be ramped gradually — initial plan attached

deploy-bot: [deploy started] dpl-2049 · prod-us-east · routing-service/v2 -> canary pinned to build: 2024.08.12-build-202 · logs: https://ci.redwood/dpl/2049

ken: quick reminder: fallback pin is 2024.07-build-199. If error_rate > 1.5% or p95 > 200ms we should roll back and set flag to 0% immediately

sofia: proposed ramp (suggested):
```
traffic_slice_v2:
  - step: 0->5%
    hold: 3m
  - step: 5->25%
    hold: 10m
  - step: 25->50%
    hold: 10m
safety:
  error_rate_delta_threshold: 0.0075  # 0.75 percentage points
  p95_threshold_ms: 200
```

mira: fine with that. also adding a manual pin command to the playbook if needed: `/model-pin routing-service 2024.07-build-199 —reason "safety rollback"`

deploy-bot: canary metrics @ 2049123460 · traffic=5% · p95=110ms (+2ms) · error_rate=0.4% · qlen=3

darin: if we see queue depth climb >12, drop batch-size to 8 and re-evaluate; i can run the throttle script if needed

mira: adding backoff rule: if error_rate increases by +0.75pp vs baseline or p95 >200ms => pause ramp, alert #inc-ff-2049, auto-pin to fallback if sustained 2min

ops-bot: monitor rule enabled for dpl-2049: error_rate_delta>0.0075 OR p95>200ms => HOLD

ken: note on capacity: dedicated pool gpu-pool-c-3 has 2 spare nodes; if we hit full utilization we should route 100% of canary traffic to dedicated pool until autoscale finishes

sofia: starting step 2 (5->25%) in 7m if all green :rocket:

deploy-bot: ramp step 1 complete at 2049123465 · traffic=5%

deploy-bot: attempting ramp step 2 at 2049123499 · change id chg-2049-2

deploy-bot: ALERT at 2049123500 · error_rate jumped to 1.9% · p95=215ms · qlen=9 — HOLD initiated

mira: observed spike, canceling further ramp. decision: rollback traffic_slice_v2 -> 0% and pin routing-service back to 2024.07-build-199. ken please execute rollback command and note in release notes

ken: executing rollback
```
# ops CLI
ops ff toggle traffic_slice_v2 0 --reason "error spike during ramp" --ch chg-2049-rollback
ops model-pin routing-service 2024.07-build-199 --ch chg-2049-rollback
```

deploy-bot: action complete at 2049123512 · traffic_slice_v2=0% · routing pinned to 2024.07-build-199 · incident created INC-2049

darin: quick postmortem checklist: collect canary traces, compare KV cache hit rates, check batching behavior during spike, save request samples to s3://redwood/ff-inc/2049

sofia: copying checklist to the release notes: "paused ramp, spike at step 2, rolled back to previous build; next attempt will include additional throttle and a 10m pre-check window"

mira: thanks everyone. follow-ups: - ops to upload metrics snapshot - eng-runtime to look for potential queue resonance with v2 kernels - product to update release notes and schedule next attempt in 24h

deploy-bot: dpl-2049 closed at 2049123590 · final state: rollback applied · notes saved to https://releases.redwood/2049

mira: creating a short post in #eng-releases with summary and timeline. :white_check_mark:
